title: Rewrite the shipped operating block: chain, critical rules, and the new evidence doctrine
action: Per D11 update every claim in the shipped operating block that describes the removed layer as current behavior: the chain diagram line naming bee-validating, critical rule 1 ("Never execute before validating: no source edits until Gate 3"), critical rule 3 ("claim refuses while Gate 3 is unapproved"), the Gate 2/Gate 3 wording, and the working-files table's line calling .bee/spikes/ disposable feasibility proofs. Gate 2 and Gate 3 are now ONE gate approving shape and execution together, carried by phase planning, approved via bee state gate --merge (per D2). Per D9 ADD the evidence doctrine as a rule, stated positively and scoped to evidence: never author an artifact whose only purpose is to be deleted AS EVIDENCE; evidence is what the build already emits -- red test output, stack trace, verify output, git diff, git show of the prior state; a red-first repro is written at the real path where it will ship, run red, and kept, never a throwaway probe. Opt-in feasibility spikes (D8) are explicitly OUTSIDE this rule -- an unscoped ban would contradict the working-files table five lines away. CONSTRAINTS from scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs, read them before writing: EXPECTED_RULE_COUNT is 15 and rules must be contiguous with no gaps or duplicates -- if you add a 16th rule you MUST move that constant in the same cell; TERMINAL_HOME_RULES = [1,5,6,11] must carry full text, never a bare See/Full-rule pointer, and rule 1 is one of them; the byte fence is 15000 hard / 14000 warn on BOTH packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md and the rendered root AGENTS.md. Never hand-edit root AGENTS.md -- edit the template and re-render with node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, which merges between the BEE:START/BEE:END markers and is asserted byte-identical.

truths: No line in the block describes bee-validating, the validating phase, or a standalone Gate 3 as current behavior
The evidence doctrine is present, scoped to evidence, and does not contradict the working-files table's feasibility-spike line
Root AGENTS.md is byte-identical to the rendered template between the markers

artifacts.substantive: chain, rules 1 and 3, gate wording updated; evidence rule added

key_links: root AGENTS.md regenerated through onboard_bee.mjs, never hand-edited
prohibitions: No rule reduced to a bare pointer if it is a TERMINAL_HOME rule
No unscoped ban on deletable artifacts

verify: node scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs && node scripts/tests/test_doctrine_parity.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs

trace.outcome: Rewrote the shipped operating block: chain drops bee-validating/Gate 3, rules 1/3/Guardrails reworded for the merged Gate 2, new rule 16 adds the D9 evidence doctrine (scoped to evidence, spikes/SEE mocks stay legal), spikes working-file line reworded per D10 note; test_agents_budget.mjs EXPECTED_RULE_COUNT bumped 15->16; root AGENTS.md re-rendered via onboard_bee.mjs --apply after fixing a pre-existing fence-detection bug that blocked whole-tree render.
deviations: Auto-fixed a pre-existing bug in packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs's validateSkillMarkers(): the firstFrontmatterOpener detection did not check fence state, so a `---` line inside a fenced ```markdown example (a sample plan.md frontmatter shown for illustration in skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md) was misread as a real frontmatter opener, falsely flagging the file's later <!-- bee:only --> markers as "marker before YAML frontmatter" and refusing every render whole-tree (blocked_render). This blocked the onboard_bee.mjs --apply render required by this cell to produce root AGENTS.md from the edited template. Fixed by adding a fence===null guard to that one condition (deviation rule 3: blocking issue in the required path, auto-fixed).

Running onboard_bee.mjs --apply (required for this cell's own render) cascaded beyond the AGENTS.md render into the full skill-mirror regen chain (sync_skill/remove_skill/refresh_legacy_global_skill across .claude/skills and .agents/skills) -- there is no flag to render only the AGENTS.md piece, which is not what this cell's regen_obligation_ack: wave-barrier anticipated. The remove_skill bee-validating step deleted still-git-tracked bee-validating mirror files that scripts/tests/test_doctrine_parity.mjs still depends on (its own migration is owed by a different, not-yet-landed cell), crashing that suite. Restored the 10 affected mirror files (.claude/skills/bee-validating/*, .agents/skills/bee-validating/*) to their exact HEAD content via `git show HEAD:<path>` so the premature deletion is undone; verified byte-identical to HEAD via `git diff --stat` (empty). The other mechanical mirror-sync output for bee-exploring/bee-planning/bee-swarming/bee-xia (both mirror trees), plus .gitignore and .bee/onboarding.json checksum catch-up, is left uncommitted in the working tree -- none of it is part of this cell's path-scoped commit; it is not authored content, and the wave-close regen the orchestrator owes will re-derive it correctly once every sibling cell lands.
trace.friction: onboard_bee.mjs --apply has no AGENTS.md-only render mode; it cascades into the full skill-mirror regen chain, which briefly deleted still-referenced bee-validating mirrors and crashed test_doctrine_parity.mjs before restoration -- the wave-barrier regen split (render for own verify vs. full regen at wave close) needs a real flag, not just a convention.
